description: This file defines a WebSocket manager class for handling WebSocket clients, connecting and disconnecting clients, and broadcasting messages in a FastAPI application.

classes.name: WsClient
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a WebSocket client with optional user ID and role.

classes.name: WsManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing WebSocket clients, including connecting, disconnecting, and broadcasting messages.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the WsManager with an empty set of clients and an asyncio lock.

methods.name: None connect(self, client: WsClient)
methods.description: Adds a WebSocket client to the manager inside an async lock.

methods.name: None disconnect(self, client: WsClient)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket client from the manager inside an async lock.

methods.name: None broadcast(self, event: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a JSON-encoded event as text to all connected WebSocket clients, removing broken connections.

ctags.name: broadcast
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast(self, event: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def connect(self, client: WsClient) -> None:$/

ctags.name: disconnect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def disconnect(self, client: WsClient) -> None:$/
